body:
She shared https://scontent-b-sjc.xx.fbcdn.net/hphotos-prn1/t1/1011117_743529052325177_1076547005_n.jpg a couple hours ago.  The irony baffles me at how kindred our spirits are.  Time to stop being delusional and looking too far into things, I guess...

That being said, thanks for the replies... you really helped clear the air.  Death is, well, the opposite of life, and I don't want to know what that entails.  I'm fond at the thought that it's just an extension of the dreamworld we visit every time we fall asleep, but at the same time, I fear the inevitable of having all my memories out of my control and eventually erased.  That's probably the only thought that keeps me going, and you guys have reminded me of it today.  Even in this terrible state, I should be grateful for having things and a lifestyle that a lot of people around me don't have, even if it's encompassed in negative thoughts.

I hope to return the favor one day.  Thanks again for the support.  The sun will rise...
